name: @clankamode/core
description: Runtime/event kernel and CLI for Clanka agent execution traces

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build -w @clankamode/core-runtime && npm run build -w @clankamode/core-cli
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @clankamode/core-runtime && npm run test -w @clankamode/core-cli
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:packages
